# Tommy Sinulingga Law Firm — Advocates & Legal Consultants (Medan & Jakarta)

> **Official Bilingual Legal Practice Dossier (`llms.txt`)**
> Established in 2020 by **Dr. Tommy Aditia Sinulingga, S.H., M.H., CTL, C.Med.** (Doctor of Law *Magna Cumlaude* FH USU, GPA 3.90; Permanent Lecturer at FH USU; Director of LKBH FH USU; Licensed PERADI Advocate; Certified Tax Lawyer; Certified Mediator). Full-service Indonesian litigation and corporate law chambers operating from **Medan (Head Office)** and **Podomoro City, West Jakarta (Branch Office)**, backed by **25 multidisciplinary legal professionals** (10 Licensed PERADI Advocates, 6 Professors & Doctors of Law on the Academic Expert Council, and 9 Certified Non-Litigation Specialists).
